It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor, HistGradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv('/app/data/train.csv')
val = pd.read_csv('/app/data/val.csv')
test = pd.read_csv('/app/data/test.csv')

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Val shape: {val.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Identify feature types
num_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('num_')]
bin_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('bin_')]
cat_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('cat_')]

print(f"Numerical: {len(num_cols)}, Binary: {len(bin_cols)}, Categorical: {len(cat_cols)}")

# Combine train and val for training
X_train_full = pd.concat([train, val], ignore_index=True)
y_train_full = X_train_full['target'].values
X_train_full = X_train_full.drop(columns=['target'])

# Prepare test data
X_test = test.copy()

# Handle categorical features - label encode
for col in cat_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    # Fit on combined data
    combined = pd.concat([X_train_full[col], X_test[col]], axis=0).astype(str)
    le.fit(combined)
    X_train_full[col] = le.transform(X_train_full[col].astype(str))
    X_test[col] = le.transform(X_test[col].astype(str))

# Fill missing values with median for numerical columns
for col in num_cols:
    median_val = X_train_full[col].median()
    if pd.isna(median_val):
        median_val = 0
    X_train_full[col] = X_train_full[col].fillna(median_val)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna(median_val)

# Fill missing binary/categorical with 0
for col in bin_cols + cat_cols:
    X_train_full[col] = X_train_full[col].fillna(0)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna(0)

print("Training HistGradientBoostingRegressor...")
model = HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
    max_iter=200,
    max_depth=10,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    random_state=42
)

model.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

print("Making predictions...")
predictions = model.predict(X_test)

print(f"Predictions shape: {predictions.shape}")
print(f"Predictions range: {predictions.min():.4f} to {predictions.max():.4f}")
print(f"Any NaN predictions: {np.isnan(predictions).any()}")
print(f"Any inf predictions: {np.isinf(predictions).any()}")

# Save predictions
result = pd.DataFrame({'target': predictions})
result.to_csv('/app/predictions.csv', index=False)

print("Saved predictions to /app/predictions.csv")
print(f"Output shape: {result.shape}")
EOF
